items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: And I was playing with Charlie Lawrence in this band of the Quality Serenaders?

ctx.x: I found a reference in a book to "Charlie's Idea": A series of variations on the chords of "Tiger Rag". Was that one of the ones you made with the Quality Serenaders?

Yes. Yes. That was one of them. Now, this Charlie was incidentally Charlie Lawrence, and Charlie Lawrence was one of the men in the band that when I was in school, I used to slip over from Pasadena to come over here and here. And I was playing with Charlie Lawrence in this band of the Quality Serenaders?
Was he a member of the Sunnyland Band you mentioned?
